official: 羽村市一般職の任期付職員の採用及び給与の特例に関する条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 任期付職員の給料表と手当を改定
summary: 任期付職員の給料や期末・勤勉手当は条例で定めています。この議案では、東京都人事委員会勧告を踏まえ、給料表と手当の支給月数を改めます。施行日は公布の日で、給料表の改定は令和7年4月1日から、手当の支給月数の改定は令和7年12月1日から適用します。
changes: 期末・勤勉手当の支給月数を改定する
why: 給与水準の公民較差を解消するためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Revises the salary table and allowances for fixed-term employees
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on the Recruitment and Special Salary Provisions for Fixed-Term Employees in General Service of Hamura City
en.summary: The salaries and year-end and performance allowances for fixed-term employees are set by ordinance. Based on a recommendation from the Tokyo Metropolitan Personnel Commission, this bill revises the salary table and the number of months paid for the allowances. The ordinance takes effect on the date of promulgation. The salary table revision applies from April 1, 2025, and the revision to the number of months paid for the allowances applies from December 1, 2025.
changes: Revises the salary table and the number of months paid for year-end and performance allowances
en.why: The city says this is to eliminate the gap between public- and private-sector salary levels.
